दर्शकों को आध्यात्मिकता की ओर आकर्षित करने के लिए कुछ सबसे प्रसिद्ध भक्ति गीतों का संकलन लगातार प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
प्रेक्षकांना अध्यात्म शोधण्यास मदत करण्यासाठी तयार केलेल्या, प्रसिद्ध आणि सुमधुर भक्तीगीतांचा हा संग्रह ऐका.

ब्रेकलेस - झकास हिट्स
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular songs sung by renowned artistes in various music genres is played back to back.
विभिन्न संगीत शैलियों में प्रसिद्ध कलाकारों द्वारा गाए गए कुछ सबसे लोकप्रिय गीतों का मधुर संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
विविध संगीत शैलीतील प्रसिद्ध कलाकारांनी सादर केलेल्या काही सर्वात लोकप्रिय गाण्यांचे विस्तृत संकलन ऐका.

programme.title: SOLID HITS
सॉलिड हिट्स
சாலிட் ஹிட்ஸ்
సాలిడ్ హిట్స్
सॉलिड हिट्स
programme.desc: A compilation of some of the greatest hits songs in popular Bollywood movies featuring renowned singers, musicians and artists.
यह कार्यक्रम, प्रसिद्ध गायकों द्वारा प्रस्तुत और संगीतबद्ध कुछ हिट् गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन पेश करता है।
ప్రముఖ గాయకులు, సంగీతకారులు స్వరపరచి ఆలపించిన ప్రసిద్ధ బాలీవుడ్ చలన చిత్రాలలోని అత్యంత ప్రజాదరణ పొందిన పాటల ప్రసారం.
प्रसिद्ध गायक, संगीतकार व कलाकारांचा समावेश असलेल्या, लोकप्रिय बॉलीवूड चित्रपटांमधील काही प्रसिद्ध गाण्यांचे संकलन ऐका.

programme.title: Bhaktinaad
भक्तिनाद
भक्तिनाद
programme.desc: A compilation of some of the most famous devotional songs are played back to back in order to help the audience find spirituality.
दर्शकों को आध्यात्मिकता की ओर आकर्षित करने के लिए कुछ सबसे प्रसिद्ध भक्ति गीतों का संकलन लगातार प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।

programme.title: Resident Evil: Poslední kapitola
programme.desc: Film přímo navazuje na události snímku Resident Evil: Odveta. Alice (Milla Jovovich) jako jediná přežije klíčový střet s nemrtvými, který měl rozhodnout o osudu lidstva. Nyní se Alice musí vrátit tam, kde celá katastrofa začala - do podzemního komplexu Hive v Raccoon City, kde společnost Umbrella Corporation hromadí své síly a chystá finální útok proti posledním hrstkám lidí, kterým se apokalypsu dosud podařilo přežít.

programme.title: Konečná
programme.desc: Šerif Ray Owens (Arnold Schwarzenegger) původně pracoval u losangeleské policie, ale po jedné zpackané akci skončil jako šerif ospalého městečka u mexických hranic, Sommerton Junction. Šéfovat bandě neschopných policistů v poklidné zašívárně, kde je nejvážnějším zločinem šťourání se v nose, není žádné umění. Dny plné nudy utne až telefonát agenta FBI Johna Bannistera (Forest Whitaker). Při převozu z Las Vegas do mexické věznice totiž uprchnul nebezpečný boss mexické mafie Gabriel Cortez (Eduardo Noriega). Během transportu ho vysvobodili členové jeho drogového kartelu a on se snaží prchnout do své domoviny. S pomocí kumpána Burella (Peter Stormare) a s rukojmím prchá Cortéz v našlapané Corvetě ZR 1 rychlostí 250 mil/hod k hranicím. Poslední překážkou na cestě ke svobodě je právě šerifovo městečko. Jenže zdejší strážci zákona a pořádku se moc netváří na to, že by se měli postavit do cesty muži, na nějž je celá FBI krátká. Jejich šéf ale nechce znovu pošpinit svou pověst, a tak...

programme.title: Na pokraji smrti
programme.desc: Píše sa rok 2002 a kalifornské úrady sa rozhodli znovu otvoriť najslávnejšiu väznicu všetkých čias - Alcatraz. Bývalý väzenský úradník Donny (Morris Chestnut), ktorý sa vydal na cestu zločinu, plánuje s pomocou špeciálneho komanda preniknúť do zmodernizovanej väznice a zistiť, kam ukryl zlato v hodnote 200 miliónov dolárov trestanec Lester, odsúdený na trest smrti

programme.title: Rozzuřený pes
programme.desc: V roce 1959 Indočínu ovládají kriminálníci - vietnamští vojáci a evropští váleční zločinci. Všude vládne bezpráví, brutální násilí a lidský život nemá žádnou cenu. Pracovní tábor Den-Dhin-Chan vedou čtyři extrémně nebezpeční zločinci. V nejhorším vězení země se ocitl bývalý světový šampion v boxu, Martin Tillman (Scott Adkins). Holý život si zachraňuje zápasení v turnajích, na kterých bohatí zločinci vydělávají vysokými sázkami na jeho vítězství. Tillman se spoléhá na to, že si tak koupí lístek na svobodu a vrátí se domů, do Evropy. Když se však blíží čas jeho propuštění, zkorumpovaní věznitelé udělají vše, co je v jejich moci, aby mu odchod znemožnili.

programme.title: Police Story 2
programme.desc: Bohatému majiteli obchodních center vyhrožuje neznámý vyděrač bombovým útokem. Cena za bezpečí je vysoká, 10 milionů dolarů. Policie se pouští do vyšetřování, ale obejde se bez svého nejlepšího člena, který se právě chystá odletět s přítelkyní na dovolenou? Nejspíš ne, a proto ho vyláká přímo z letadla, aby mohl celou akci vést. Přes překupníky dynamitu se dostane až k vyděračům. Ti jsou ale ještě nebezpečnější, než si dovedl představit, a neváhají unést jeho přítelkyni. V tu chvíli se pro něj tento případ stává osobní záležitostí.

programme.title: Knight Rider 2
programme.desc: V neveľmi vzdialenej budúcnosti sú zakázané všetky zbrane a zločincov na dobu ich trestu hibernujú. Keď začnú v uliciach mesta vystrájať ozbrojení gauneri, na pomoc povolajú nekompromisného strážcu zákona Michaela Knighta (DAVID HASSELHOFF), ktorého verným pomocníkom je umelou inteligenciou disponujúci čierny Pontiac nazývaný K.I.T.T. Vyjde však najavo, že auto bolo deaktivované. Podarí sa ho uviesť znovu do prevádzky a spolu s Mikeom zločincov eliminovať a navrátiť pokoj do ulíc?

programme.title: Superpolicajti z Miami
programme.desc: V Super policajtech z Miami se setkáme s našimi hrdiny (Bud Spencer a Terence Hill), tentokráte v rolích dvou odvážných bojovníků se zločinem, kteří jsou na stopě 20 miliónů dolarů, které byly před několika lety ukradeny při vloupání. Při hledání peněz - a zloděje - , při čemž jim samozřejmě trochu pomáhají i dvě krásné dívky, nesmí chybět vražda, nelítostné rvačky a děsný blázinec!

programme.title: Superpolicajti z Miami
programme.desc: V Super policajtech z Miami se setkáme s našimi hrdiny (Bud Spencer a Terence Hill), tentokráte v rolích dvou odvážných bojovníků se zločinem, kteří jsou na stopě 20 miliónů dolarů, které byly před několika lety ukradeny při vloupání. programme.title: Rytíři nebes
programme.desc: Akční velkofilm odehrávající se v atraktivním prostředí leteckých bitev 1. světové války, který se inspiroval skutečnými událostmi. Čeká Vás dobrodružství legendární Lafayettovy eskadry tvořené americkými stíhacími piloty. Ti se dobrovolně přihlásili do bojů ve Francii. Mladí letci se tak vydávají do vzdálené Evropy hnáni touhou naučit se létat na nových strojích a zažít velká dobrodružství. Ve válkou zmítané Francii se zpočátku naivní mladíci naučí pravému smyslu přátelství, odvahy i lásky a získají tak opravdové důvody pro riskování vlastního života.

programme.title: Zatím spolu, zatím živi
programme.desc: V akční komedii je Tom Cruise tajným agentem a Cameron Diaz ženou polapenou mezi ním a těmi, kteří ho - podle jeho tvrzení - do této situace dostali. S tím, jak se jejich divoké dobrodružství mění v bludiště podfuků, úniků na poslední chvíli, falešných identit a opojných romantických, ale naprosto zmatených situací, zjišťují, že jediné, na co se mohou spoléhat, jsou oni dva navzájem. Dvojici hvězdných představitelů doplňují ve vedlejších rolích Paul Dano (Až na krev, Malá Miss Sunshine), Viola Davis (Pochyby) či Peter Sarsgaard (Škola života).

programme.title: Bláznivý šaman - Zpátky z minulosti
programme.desc: Pokračování stejnojmenného filmu z roku 2001, které líčí nová dobrodružství bílého afrického kouzelníka.

programme.title: Bláznivý šaman - Zpátky z minulosti
programme.desc: Pokračování stejnojmenného filmu z roku 2001, které líčí nová dobrodružství bílého afrického kouzelníka.

programme.title: K-19: Stroj na smrt
programme.desc: Dramatický příběh na motivy skutečných událostí. Rok 1961, severní Atlantik. První sovětská jaderná ponorka s označením K-19 se vydala na svojí první ostrou plavbu. Ještě před vypuštěním na otevřené moře si kvůli sérii nešťastných nehod vysloužila přezdívku výrobce vdov. Už zanedlouho po vyplutí tato přezdívka získá další opodstatnění, protože vedená dvěma veliteli-rivaly, se ponorka opět dostane do velkých problémů. V lepším případě jen rozšíří dlouhou sérii velkých neštěstí 20.století, v tom horším se může stát příčinou nukleární exploze, která přivede obě supervelmoci studené války ke zničujícímu nukleárnímu konfliktu. Osud světa nyní leží v rukách vystrašených námořníků, a bude záležet na schopnostech obou velitelů, zda překonajít osobní neshody tváří v tvář hrozící katastrofě.

programme.title: Jezdci Apokalypsy
programme.desc: Aidan Breslin je zkušený detektiv, který se stále nevzpamatoval ze smrti své manželky. Zatímco vyšetřuje případ nezvykle brutálních vražd, zjišťuje, že existuje nějaké děsivé spojení mezi ním a vrahem. Klíčem se zdají být biblická proroctví spojená se čtyřmi jezdci Apokalypsy: Válkou, Hladem, Morem a Smrtí...

programme.title: Kamarád taky rád
programme.desc: Dylan (Justin Timberlake) a Jamie (Mila Kunis) rozhodně nemají na usedlý život ani pomyšlení. Když si Newyorčanka Jamie, zaměstnaná jako hledačka nových příležitostí, vyzkouší své umění na uměleckém řediteli Dylanovi z Los Angeles, kterého přemluví, aby vzal svou vysněnou práci v New Yorku, uvědomí si oba, že jsou si velice podobní. Každý z nich má za sebou tolik zkrachovalých vztahů, že jsou ochotni zkrátka pustit lásku z hlavy a starat se jen o zábavu. Jakmile se tedy Dylan přestěhuje do New Yorku a začnou se spolu vídat častěji, užívají si spoustu legrace a sdílejí přesvědčení, že láska je jen mýtus z hollywoodských filmů. A právě tehdy se rozhodnou vyzkoušet báječně sexy a uvědoměle dospělý experiment. Mohou dva kamarádi, kteří se teprve nedávno poznali, nejsou zadaní a pohrdají závazky, ze svého kamarádství vytěžit ještě o něco víc? Rozšíří-li své přátelství o příležitostný, zcela nezávazný sex "bez jakýchkoliv emocí", dokáží se vyhnout všem úskalím, která se nutně...

programme.title: Fighter
programme.desc: Hvězdně obsazené biografické drama The Fighter v hlavních rolích s Markem Wahlbergem a Christianem Balem vypráví skutečný příběh o nepravděpodobné cestě Mickyho Warda za boxerským titulem v kategorii velterovy váhy. V jeho rockyovské cestě jej vedl nevlastní bratr Dicky, bývalý šampión, který kdysi úspěšnou kariéru vyměnil za drogy a kriminální činnost. Touha porazit soupeře v ringu se mění i v boj za rodinu a vlastní hrdost.

programme.title: Johanka z Arku
programme.desc: Johanka (Milla Jovovich) byla malou holčičkou, když jí během přepadení její rodné vesnice vojáci anglické armády před očima znásilnili a zavraždili sestru. Od té doby se staly víra a modlitby její jedinou útěchou. Když Johanka dospěla, začala být přesvědčena, že k ní hovoří sám Bůh (Dustin Hoffman) a že jí vyzývá k tomu, aby se postavila do čela armády, která vyžene vetřelce a přinese její zemi mír. Johančino nezlomné odhodlání překonává původní nedůvěru jejích přátel i rodiny.

programme.title: Věrná kopie
programme.desc: Náhoda svede v italském Toskánsku dohromady muže a ženu. Muž je britský spisovatel a přijel hovořit o své knize, žena je Francouzka a má tady malou výtvarnou síň. Během výletu za skvostnými památkami je lidé celkem logicky považují za dvojici. A bůhví proč, žena rozehraje hru, v níž se ztotožňuje s rolí manželky. Po krátkém zdráhání muž na hru přistoupí. A tak nakonec nevíme, kde končí hra a začíná pravda - nebo naopak. První film, který slavný íránský tvůrce Abbas Kiarostami natočil v Evropě, vznikl podle hlavní představitelky Juliette Binocheové na základě zážitku, o němž jí tvůrce sugestivně vyprávěl, aby pak vzápětí popřel, že je pravdivý.

programme.title: Police Story 3
programme.desc: Nejlepší hongkongský policajt je vyslán do Číny s úkolem zneškodnit drogového magnáta. Aby se dostal až k němu, musí pomoci jeho bratrovi uprchnout z pracovního tábora, získat si jeho důvěru a proniknout tak do organizace. V celé akci mu pomáhá půvabná čínská agentka. Nešťastnou náhodou je ale jejich utajení prozrazeno. Z už tak dost nebezpečného úkolu se stává boj o život.

programme.title: Zůstaň se mnou
programme.desc: Milují se k zbláznění... Potkali se na vysoké v New Yorku. Al chce pokračovat v kuchařském umění svého otce. Půvabná Imogen se věnuje malování. Jediné, co si ještě nenaplánovali, byla láska. Vpadla mezi ně a dělá s nimi divy! Jenže Imogen si začne uvědomovat, že by mohla přijít svatba, dítě... a svobodo i kariéro, jaké jste byly? Al je do dívky blázen a snaží se za každou cenu si právě nalezenou lásku udržet. Není to ale vůbec jednoduché. A tak se milují, rozcházejí, smiřují, dělají si naschvály... Má vůbec první láska šanci stát se tou pravou?

programme.title: Zůstaň se mnou
programme.desc: Milují se k zbláznění... Potkali se na vysoké v New Yorku. Al chce pokračovat v kuchařském umění svého otce. Půvabná Imogen se věnuje malování. Jediné, co si ještě nenaplánovali, byla láska. Vpadla mezi ně a dělá s nimi divy! Jenže Imogen si začne uvědomovat, že by mohla přijít svatba, dítě... a svobodo i kariéro, jaké jste byly? Al je do dívky blázen a snaží se za každou cenu si právě nalezenou lásku udržet. Není to ale vůbec jednoduché. A tak se milují, rozcházejí, smiřují, dělají si naschvály... Má vůbec první láska šanci stát se tou pravou?

programme.title: Pravá a levá ruka ďábla
programme.desc: Joe Trinity, jehož přezdívají pro umění zacházet s revolverem Pravá ruka ďábla, přichází do městečka, kde je jeho bratr Bambino, Levá ruka ďábla, šerifem. Pravda, šerifem falešným, protože toho pravého postřelil, a tak ho zastupuje, než přijdou jeho komplici, aby připravili loupež. Místo toho se však bratři musí postavit na stranu zákona a chránit osadníky před nenasytným vlastníkem půdy a stáda koní Harrimanem..

programme.title: (J)elita ze střídačky
programme.desc: Pro každého, po kom se někdy někdo vozil, koho někdy někdo složil nebo s ním zametl, jsou tady ti praví hrdinové! Rob Schneider, David Spade a Jon Heder se představují v rolích postarších chlápků, kteří moc dobře vědí, jaké to je, když si na ně někdo došlápne. Potom, co načapali partu zákeřných dětí ze sousedství, jak si dovolují na kamarádova syna, rozhodnou se pomstít tím, že dají dohromady tříčlenný baseballový tým a vyzvou nejlepší tým státní juniorské ligy. Největší fanoušky sice získávají mezi místními křupany, potrhlíky a zkrachovalými existencemi, ale naši outsideři si v komedii režiséra Dennise Dugana (Velký táta a Rivalové) a producenta Adama Sandlera užijou a vy jistě také.

programme.title: Uprchlíci
programme.desc: Jean Lucas je propuštěn z vězení, kde si odpykával pětiletý trest za bankovní loupeže. Komisař Duroc, který ho zatýkal, na něj čeká před věznicí, aby mu sdělil, že nevěří, že by vedl vzorný život a hodlá ho sledovat. Až ho znovu zatkne, bude povýšen. Lucas však hodlá žít jako slušný občan a najít si práci. Má nějaké šperky, které prodá a utržené peníze si chce uložit v bance. Má však hroznou smůlu protože banku přepadne zmatený Francois Pignon, který si navíc Lucase vybere jako rukojmí. Ve Francii není jediný policista, který by pochyboval o tom, že to byl právě Lucas, který přepadení provedl. Pignon donutí Lucase, aby nasedl do jeho auta, a odjedou. Je však tak nešikovný, že nechtěně Lucase postřelí do nohy. Lucas chce k lékaři, ale Pignon si nemůže dovolit jít do vězení. Musí se starat o svou šestiletou dceru Jeanne, se kterou zůstal sám. Zaveze tedy Lucase ke svému známému veterináři, kde ho ošetří. Pignon je zoufalý a proto se odhodlal k tak zoufalému činu. Kdysi býval...

programme.title: Neprůstřelný mnich
programme.desc: Tajemný mnich, legendární čínský mistr kung-fu, už šedesát let cestuje po světě s magickým svitkem, jenž dodává svému majiteli neomezenou sílu. Dnes musí najít svého nástupce, zodpovědného člověka, kterému by svitek mohl předat. Kar je mladý, do sebe zahleděný sanfranciský výrostek a pouliční spekulant. Když mnichovi jednoho dne zachrání život, zvolí si ho za svého následníka. To však ještě netuší, co je Kar zač a kolik práce ho bude stát naučit jej zodpovědnosti... Ve snímku plném svěžího humoru a rychlých karate mlátiček si hlavní zápornou roli kung-fu zloducha, usilujícího o magický svitek, zahrál Karel Roden, který kvůli této roli absolvoval tvrdé lekce kung-fu.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: Caleb Smith (Domhnall Gleeson), šestadvacetiletý programátor největší internetové společnosti na světě, vyhraje soutěž o týdenní pobyt na soukromém horském sídle geniálního a samotářského ředitele společnosti Nathana Batemana (Oscar Isaac). Když však Caleb dorazí na odlehlé místo, zjistí, že se bude muset zúčastnit podivného a fascinujícího experimentu, v němž je nucen komunikovat s první skutečnou umělou inteligencí na světě, umístěnou v těle krásné robotické dívky Avy (Alicia Vikanderová).

programme.title: Tremors: Ostrov Shriekerů
programme.desc: Skupina zbohatlických lovců trofejí pod vedením Billa (Richard Brake) má v úmyslu na odlehlém tropickém ostrově uspořádat lovecký zážitek svého života.

programme.title: Tremors: Ostrov Shriekerů
programme.desc: Skupina zbohatlických lovců trofejí pod vedením Billa (Richard Brake) má v úmyslu na odlehlém tropickém ostrově uspořádat lovecký zážitek svého života.

programme.title: Na pokraji smrti
programme.desc: Píše sa rok 2002 a kalifornské úrady sa rozhodli znovu otvoriť najslávnejšiu väznicu všetkých čias - Alcatraz. Bývalý väzenský úradník Donny (Morris Chestnut), ktorý sa vydal na cestu zločinu, plánuje s pomocou špeciálneho komanda preniknúť do zmodernizovanej väznice a zistiť, kam ukryl zlato v hodnote 200 miliónov dolárov trestanec Lester, odsúdený na trest smrti

programme.title: Rozzuřený pes
programme.desc: V roce 1959 Indočínu ovládají kriminálníci - vietnamští vojáci a evropští váleční zločinci. Všude vládne bezpráví, brutální násilí a lidský život nemá žádnou cenu. Pracovní tábor Den-Dhin-Chan vedou čtyři extrémně nebezpeční zločinci. V nejhorším vězení země se ocitl bývalý světový šampion v boxu, Martin Tillman (Scott Adkins). Holý život si zachraňuje zápasení v turnajích, na kterých bohatí zločinci vydělávají vysokými sázkami na jeho vítězství. Tillman se spoléhá na to, že si tak koupí lístek na svobodu a vrátí se domů, do Evropy. Když se však blíží čas jeho propuštění, zkorumpovaní věznitelé udělají vše, co je v jejich moci, aby mu odchod znemožnili.

programme.title: Univerzální voják
programme.desc: Při masakru vietnamské vesnice se americký voják Luc dostává do konfliktu se šíleným seržantem Scottem. Oba muži se navzájem zabijí... O třiadvacet let později se na scéně objevují znovu jako příslušníci speciálního protiteroristického komanda - univerzální vojáci. Zvláštní oddělení ministerstva obrany z jejich těl vyvinulo nezničitelné stroje na zabíjení. Při záchranné akci v útrobách mamutí přehrady ohrožované teroristy se Lucovi začnou vynořovat vzpomínky na jeho minulý život. Vymkne se kontrole svých tvůrců a dává se na útěk, ve kterém mu pomáhá mladá novinářka Veronika. Nejzuřivějším pronásledovatelem prchající dvojice se stává krví posedlý Scott. Nemilosrdně ničí vše, co se mu postaví do cesty. K rozhodujícímu souboji na život a na smrt se schyluje na farmě Lucových rodičů, kteří nemohou uvěřit tomu, že jejich syn vstal z mrtvých...

programme.title: Miluj souseda svého
programme.desc: Vincent (Bill Murray) je stárnoucí válečný veterán jak se patří - mrzutý a nepříjemný na všechny lidi. Když se do sousedního domu nastěhují noví sousedé, jeho poklidný život se obrátí vzhůru nohama a on má najednou každý den na krku 12letého kluka. Ačkoliv je Vincent cynik, který sází, miluje whisky a dost často navštěvuje striptýzové kluby, nakonec se z něj stane ten nejlepší přítel pro chlapce, který se právě vyrovnává s rozvodem svých rodičů, novou školou a novým životem.

programme.title: Malý indián ve městě
programme.desc: Stéphane je úspěšný burzovní makléř. Do dneška nepochopil, proč od něj jednoho dne žena beze slova odešla. A teď se chce rozvést a musí za svou ženou do amazonských pralesů, kde nyní žije. O tom, že má třináctiletého syna, neměl ani potuchy. Chlapec se jmenuje Mimi Siku, což v překladu znamená něco jako "kočičí chcanky". Jména si totiž děti v indiánské vesnici Lipo Lipo vybírají samy, když jsou jim čtyři roky. Stéphane má sebou sice mobilní telefon a notebook s anténou, ale ve vesnici Lipo Lipo plyne čas jinak než na burze v Paříži, elektrickou zástrčku tam jen sotva najde a o tom, co je skutečně důležité, mají indiáni zcela jasno.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: Bývalý šampion v bowlingu, Roy, objevil mladého génia jménem Ishmael a má za to, že tento chlapec je jeho vstupenkou do světa úspěchu a bohatství. Roy vezme Ishmaela na turnaj "vítěz bere vše" do Rena, aby se pomstil svému dávnému rivalovi. Roy Munson se stal v roce 1979 národním šampionem v bowlingu. Bohužel brzy poté, co získal titul, přišel o ruku - zapletl se totiž s nesprávnými chlápky a snažil se je podvést. Posledních sedmnáct let bylo pro Roye velmi neradostných, s gumovou rukou se živil jako prodejce bowlingového vybavení. Jednoho dne se však setká s Ishmaelem, mladým Amišem, jenž má přirozený talent pro bowling. Roy chlapce přesvědčí, aby s ním odjel na profesionální bowlingový turnaj, kde má šanci díky svému nadání vyhrát slušnou finanční sumu a zachránit tak rodinnou farmu. Netrvá dlouho a Ishmael začne vyhrávat jednu soutěž za druhou... Drsná a vtipná komedie však na konci velmi zvážní.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Paralelní světy
programme.desc: Spider-Man: Paralelní světy představí dospívajícího chlapce z Brooklynu Milese Moralese a nekonečné možnosti Paralelních světů, kde je víc než jen jeden maskovaný hrdina

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: V nejnovějším pokračování série o legendárním mistru Wing Chun Ip Man (Donnie Yen) čelí nejen hongkongskému gangu, jehož hlavu si zahrála boxerská legenda Mike Tyson, ale musí se vypořádat rovněž s vlastním rodinným životem. Ve městě protkaném korupcí, ve kterém se ho zároveň neustále pokouší konfrontovat konkurenční mistr Wing Chun, to však nemá jednoduché.

programme.title: Zvíře
programme.desc: Úředník v policejní kartotéce Marvin sní o tom, že se stane plnohodnotným policistou jako jeho otec - jenom musí projít testy na fyzickou odolnost. Jednou v noci zůstane Marvin v celé budově sám a přijme tísňové volání na číslo 911. Sám se přižene zabránit loupeži. Lupiči uprchnou a Marvin, který je pronásleduje, má strašnou havárii v autě. Zachrání ho výstřední doktor Wilder který bádá nad změnou genetického kódu. Ve své soukromé laboratoři transplantuje Marvinovi různé zvířecí orgány. Když se Marvin vrátí ke své práci na stanici, na Wilderův zákrok si vůbec nepamatuje. Své kolegy však udivuje vypracovanými svaly a podivným zápachem, který ho provází. Navenek vypadá normálně, ale uvnitř nikdy neví, který zvířecí instinkt v něm zrovna převáží. Poté, co vyčenichá pašeráky drog na letišti, stává se z Marvina hrdina. Konečně se stává policistou. Jeho život se však začíná komplikovat, když se zamiluje do Rianny, která pracuje jako dobrovolnice v místním zvířecím útulku.

programme.title: Smlouva s ďáblem
programme.desc: Elliot Richards je nesmělý dobrák zamilovaný do své kolegyně Alison. Ta ho však vůbec nebere na vědomí, proto se zoufalý Elliot rozhodne přijmout nabídku atraktivní ďáblice. Za jeho duši mu splní sedm přání. Jenže ďáblice má trochu svérázný smysl pro humor. Elliot vysloví první přání a skutečně se probudí v luxusním sídle s Alison po boku. Brzy ale zjistí, že Alison je mu nevěrná a jeho bohatství pochází z obchodu s drogami. Podruhé si tedy Elliot raději přeje, aby byl mužem plným pochopení, ale malíř slzející nad západem slunce Alison také na dlouho nezaujme. Vinou ďáblice neuspěje ani mohutný basketbalista ani okouzlující intelektuál, jemuž vedle Pullitzerovy ceny přisoudí i poněkud problematickou sexuální orientaci. S každým přáním je sice Elliot o něco moudřejší, ale také o něco blíž peklu. A než se naděje, zbývá mu poslední přání.

programme.title: Klub vyděračů
programme.desc: Neil a Abby Warnerovi maji perfektní život a perfektní manželství. Se svojí překrásnou dcerou Sophií žijí svůj americký sen...až do dneška. Sophie je totiž náhle unesena, a oni nemají žádnou jinou možnost, než vyhovět únoscovým požadavkům.

programme.title: Zběsilý útěk
programme.desc: Prvotřídní, krutě šokující, akční film, který s vámi otřese jako nic předtím. Zbraň, která zabila zkorumpovaného policistu se omylem stane nástrojem pomsty v rukou dvou desetiletých kluků. Otec jednoho z nich, malá gangsterská ryba Joey Gazelle (Paul Walker), se náhle ocitá v dosahu ruské mafie, která za každou cenu chce dopadnout a zlikvidovat toho, kdo připravil o život jednoho z jejich významných členů (Karel Roden). Začíná kolotoč omylů, podrazů a především velkých problémů. Pro Joeyho to bude hodně krušná noc a jestli nenajde tu zbraň včas, mohla by být i jeho poslední.

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection. Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers. Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, “K-Chat: Travel in Korea” What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers. Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: K-CHAT: Travel in Korea
programme.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, “K-Chat: Travel in Korea” What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. It also covers traditional Korean culture and essential travel information, making it an invaluable resource for beginner to intermediate learners! Discover Korean travel expressions in an engaging and entertaining way with skits performed by ONF’s Hyo-jin, Seung-jun, Wyatt, and Alexa. With clear and accessible explanations from Hye-rim of the Wonder Girls, a graduate of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, you’ll systematically improve your Korean!

We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: K-CHAT: Travel in Korea
programme.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, “K-Chat: Travel in Korea” What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. It also covers traditional Korean culture and essential travel information, making it an invaluable resource for beginner to intermediate learners! Discover Korean travel expressions in an engaging and entertaining way with skits performed by ONF’s Hyo-jin, Seung-jun, Wyatt, and Alexa. With clear and accessible explanations from Hye-rim of the Wonder Girls, a graduate of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, you’ll systematically improve your Korean!

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection. programme.title: SHOW K-POP
programme.desc: Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias. FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: SHOW K-POP
programme.desc: Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias. FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. programme.title: SHOW K-POP
programme.desc: Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias. FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: K-CHAT: Travel in Korea
programme.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, “K-Chat: Travel in Korea” What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. It also covers traditional Korean culture and essential travel information, making it an invaluable resource for beginner to intermediate learners! Discover Korean travel expressions in an engaging and entertaining way with skits performed by ONF’s Hyo-jin, Seung-jun, Wyatt, and Alexa. With clear and accessible explanations from Hye-rim of the Wonder Girls, a graduate of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, you’ll systematically improve your Korean!

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection. Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers. Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: K-CHAT: Travel in Korea

In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: K-CHAT: Travel in Korea
programme.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, “K-Chat: Travel in Korea” What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. It also covers traditional Korean culture and essential travel information, making it an invaluable resource for beginner to intermediate learners! Discover Korean travel expressions in an engaging and entertaining way with skits performed by ONF’s Hyo-jin, Seung-jun, Wyatt, and Alexa. With clear and accessible explanations from Hye-rim of the Wonder Girls, a graduate of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, you’ll systematically improve your Korean!

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Countryside Escape

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: The Traitors Ireland
programme.desc: The doors of Slane Castle have opened once again, with 23 new players entering The Traitors Ireland for its second season. The line-up features contestants from across the country, ranging in age from 24 to 61 and including teachers, a postal worker, a psychotherapist, a musician, a stay-at-home dad, an Irish Defence Forces member, and an actor and drama teacher. Hosted once again by Siobhán McSweeney, the players attempt to navigate a game built on trust, strategy and deception, forming alliances while trying to work out who among them they can believe.

programme.title: Dashcam Justice
programme.desc: A £20,000 crash claim looks convincing until fraud investigators spot one tiny clue. Near Liverpool, a lorry smashes into a minibus carrying a child to school, but a second camera reveals a troubling twist. In Wigan, a motorist tears past a learner across double white lines. Cameras front and rear capture the manoeuvre, giving police the evidence to pursue the case.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Programme in which experts uncover the various tricks of the property auction trade

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Let battle commence! Charlie Ross visits the Royal Armouries Museum in Leeds to see an impressive collection of human, horse and elephant armour. Another battle (of the bargains) is taking place at an antiques fair in Wetherby, waged by two teams of friends. In the red corner, it’s pals Hannah and Verity, captained by Izzie Balmer. Their opponents in blue are boat fitters Giles and Huw, skippered by David Harper. The blues make an early pit stop to look at old oil cans, but they go on the back burner. Meanwhile, the reds go potty over northern pottery and pick up a piggy vesta case, but they’re not sure it’ll bring home the bacon at auction. Derby is the destination for the sale, where auctioneer Sean Devitt is on the rostrum. But which team will clinch victory?

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: The team track a truly evil scam which sees an elderly couple being terrified into believing their computer has been used for highly illegal activity. Unable to contact the victims on the phone, they dispatch a ground team to the couple’s house. The team also try to prevent a remote access scam in Surrey. As they struggle to get through and stop it, a second ground team are sent out. The victim is not convinced, though – and a battle to persuade him that the ground team are on his side follows.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When Shaz receives a package he didn’t order, he turns doorbell detective and discovers a man intercepting deliveries on his doorstep, pretending to be him. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan demonstrates a simple doorstep scam on pensioner Beryl and gives her some tips to avoid it happening. And what would you do if you caught a burglar in the act of robbing your house? That's what doorbell detective Ethan faced.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Briony May Williams helps discerning house hunters from a town in Kent relocate to the quieter countryside of Norfolk and Suffolk. With three dogs and an impressive collection of cars and motorcycles, there’s plenty to accommodate. So, finding a home that’s not too big, not too small, but just right proves quite the challenge. Briony also pulls on her waders in the River Waveney to discover what’s being done to keep its waters clean for wild swimmers.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: The team face their quirkiest fix yet – a giant fibreglass cow lantern. Also, luthier Julyan brings a banjolele back to life, and Dom gets a crash course in brilliant cutting.

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Five contestants – Gaynor, Conor, Emmanuel, Eleri and John – battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Stacey & Joe
programme.desc: A tense camping trip, a lost wedding ring and goat yoga - all whilst a possible move from Pickle Cottage takes a big step forward.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: Warren Arter was seen as a star detective in the Metropolitan Police, but he was also a sexual predator. He used his position running a rape and sexual offences unit to groom and sexually exploit vulnerable women whose cases he investigated. But the Met missed a string of opportunities to stop Arter and then suspended him on full pay for almost seven years before finally dismissing him for drug offences in 2023. In 2024, he was with his wife Rebekah when she died in a hotel room in Barbados in mysterious circumstances. Reporter Noel Titheradge investigates the case that has been called the Met's 'dirty secret' and tracks down new witnesses who tell him what really happened. Could Rebekah's death have been prevented? And why didn't the Met act sooner to stop the predator in its ranks?

programme.title: Dashcam Justice
programme.desc: A speeding driver tears down a Rhyl street, wrecking cars and nearly killing a bystander pumping up his tyres. With no dashcam recording, crucial evidence comes from an unexpected source. An angry motorist takes a roundabout the wrong way to pursue another driver, while on the M4 near Newport, a lorry smashes into a car along the carriageway. A friend's dashcam holds the key to who's to blame.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Dion and Martel are criss-crossing the country in Bolsover, Dawley and Darlington, looking at three ambitious property projects ripe for renovation or conversion. The former working men's club, a cottage with a magnificent garden and a three-bedroom semi-detached were all sold at auction, and the three sets of buyers all have to overcome unforeseen issues to get their projects over the line.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: It’s up, up and away for an aeronautical edition of the show from Nottinghamshire. In Newark, Danny Sebastian visits a local college that saved a former passenger jet from the scrapheap and transformed it into a classroom for youngsters training to work in the air industry. Hoping to land a few deals of their own are Mel and Jodie on the red team, and Anne and Olivia on the blue team. At a misty antiques fair at Newark Showground, they dash around the stalls in search of three items they hope will sell for a profit at auction in Nottingham. First to spot a potential purchase is Jodie, but her expert Izzie Balmer isn’t mincing her words when it comes to saying no. The blues are thinking about ceramics, with a 1970s plate featuring yachts, but given the hefty price tag, the team decide not to sail away with it. Auctioneer Hettie Jago is wielding her gavel, but which team will come out on top?

programme.title: BBC News at One

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: The team are joined in the hub by ethical hacker Jim Browning as they focus on a scammer who seems to be from the UK. He runs recovery scams, supposedly helping individuals recover lost funds, only to extort them for more money. With Jim’s help, the team work out that the British scammer, who is truly cruel to his victims, is working from an apartment block in Tbilisi, Georgia. With so much information on the scammer, can it help them to stop him defrauding a man at home in the UK?

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: Cheryl turns doorbell detective when she discovers a dodgy duo taking her kid’s bike from her garden, but with the help of other victims, do they manage to crack the case?
